sources.label: MySpoti
sources.author: MySpoti
patch_list: Adds Export & storage to Settings > Downloads in MySpoti 2.3.0, local-first playback for downloaded tracks, tagged audio exports, offline lyrics resolution/cache, portable LRC and JSON lyrics, embedded lyrics, playlist/album M3U8 manifests…
Renames MySpoti to Spotify and replaces every launcher, themed, supporter-preview, splash, widget, and notification mark with Spotify branding.
